text:
maria: Started v2 canary to staging (us-west) a few mins ago — deploybot flagged a prober mismatch. Saw 502s for tenants 'atlas' and 'drift' ~30s into warmup. Recommend pause + quick triage?

deploybot: [deploybot] Canary deploy 6422223333 (staging/us-west) — healthcheck failing. 502 x8 in last 15s, auto-pause threshold met, paused at 16:06Z.

kevin: Can someone grab the prober logs? Want to know if this is real service error or header/routing mismatch.

sara: grabbing logs now, will paste top lines.

sara: ```
prober: recv request id=9c2a path=/v2/generate headers={X-API-Version:v1, User-Agent:prober/1.2}
service: forwarded to v2-backend -> remote responded 502
proxy: expected X-API-Version:v2 for v2 route, got v1 -> handler rejected
```

josh: Okay that explains it — prober is sending v1 version header, so request lands on v2 route but payload/contract mismatch causes 502. Looks like the staging shim that rewrites the probe header didn't apply.

maria: Is this a simple gateway config miss that we can hotpatch, or do we need to rollback the canary to v1?

kevin: Hotpatch would be small: add a staging-only header rewrite so probes present X-API-Version:v2. Risk is low if we scope to staging. Alternative is rollback to v1 to unblock other tests. Ops decision.

sara: I can prepare a config tweak: `gateway.rewrite.headers.add X-API-Version:v2 if env==staging && path~^/v2` — additive, no route changes. PR and CI should be quick.

ops-lead: Ops can review. If PR lands within 10m we can avoid rollback. If not, rollback to v1 and re-run preflight.

maria: :thumbsup: ops eyes on. Also update release notes to call out we added a staging-only prober shim so future probes include the correct header.

josh: If we hotpatch, please ensure the change is behind a canary flag scoped to the staging cluster only — do NOT apply to prod.

deploybot: [deploybot] Manual resume required. To resume run: `/deploy resume 6422223333` (blocked while paused).

kevin: prepping diff now, will post snippet.

kevin: ```diff
- gateway.config.probers: []
+ gateway.config.probers: [ { match: "/v2", rewrite: { "X-API-Version": "v2" }, scope: "staging-only" } ]
```

sara: PR #5123 opened: staging-only header rewrite. CI passing for config lint. Ops review requested.

ops-lead: Reviewing PR now. Quick check: does this touch any routing tables or TTLs?

sara: No routing table changes. Pure header rewrite on ingress prober path. No TTLs.

ops-lead: LGTM. Merging and will run `/deploy resume`.

deploybot: [deploybot] Merge detected for PR #5123. Action required: manual resume by operator.

ops-lead: Merged and resuming canary now. `/deploy resume 6422223333` — resuming.

deploybot: [deploybot] Resume accepted. Canary resumed at 16:15Z. Monitoring healthchecks.

maria: Monitoring looks clean so far, probe errors gone for atlas/drift. Good catch.

josh: Follow-up: add a preflight check to ensure probe header rewrites exist for all staging shims before canary starts. Opened ticket T-1234 for the checklist.

maria: I'll update the release notes: add a blurb about the staging shim and the preflight we added. Also note operator handoff procedure in case deploybot auto-pauses again.

kevin: minor retrospective: ensure the config generation pipeline includes the prober rewrite in the staging manifest. I'll add a linter rule.

maria: Thanks team — closing thread once T-1234 is triaged. :white_check_mark:
